name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 10 – Am 100
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 10c. Rejects the stigmatisation or political instrumentalisation of young Muslim citizens and their organised efforts to participate in consultation and decision-making processes established by the European institutions; stresses that any action against demonstrable threats to democratic processes must be based on clear, objective and individually assessed evidence, and must respect freedom of religion, association and expression;
